C1 commentary · 223 words
## bodh-p01-v01 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Oṃ to Netra; constant salute to five-act Śiva, supreme-self bliss manifest. Consciousness free, world's cause so-called; knower freedom-formed, powers bestowed. Own ground, own will, world's unfolding; fit variety divides seer-seen. World's variety stands by object-difference, manifold-yoked high-low-numbered. Tightened knowing becomes mind, knower still; banyan-seed holds world-form, wise-known. Self's stainless knowing, rule-bound, named mind-knowing. Object-faced awareness rests in mind; the wise know mind as knowing. Knower knowing-formed abides embodied, clinging, discernment-void. Mind ever-one established through listed means and counts. Lord everywhere-pure; mis-knowing I-ness brings freedom palm-close. *Rasa: maṅgala-bhakti of invocation; vīra of free cause; adbhuta of unborrowing unfolding; adbhuta of arranged variety; adbhuta of knower-tightened; śānta of stainless naming; śānta of rested awareness; karuṇa of bound knower; vīra of established oneness; adbhuta of palm-close freedom — The sthāyibhāva is love-address: Oṃ, salute, salute. Invoking relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: free, cause, bestowing. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: own ground, own will, divided fitness. Unfolding relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: difference arranging high-low. Arrangement relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: tightened yet knower, seed-contained. Tightening relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: stainless, bound, still knowing. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: rested, known by wise. Knowing relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion: knowing-shaped, discernment-void. Binding beheld. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: ever-one, means-counted. Establishment relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: mis-known, palm-close. Nearness relished.*

C1 commentary · 200 words
## bodh-p02-v11 — C1 **SUMMARY.** By seven-knowerhood, by thirty-six count cultivated: the great Lord tends, release-glory proceeds. Stages doubtless yet made-up, actor-assumed by will. Vast-assumed shining; own-power-tightened impurity in wandering. Incompleteness confessed in impurities' words; Lordship kept all-pervading. Five acts mirrored god-to-self; delusion sole difference. Capable sung of expansion; contracted called wanderer of contraction. Willing glimpse, knowing made-making; keeping and withdrawn-loosing deemed. Withdrawn goddess graces oneness; essence-showing named concealment. Ever-present course known as jewel; unknowing timber-clod. *Rasa: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: tended, tending, proceeding. Tending relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: doubtless, made-up, actor-assumed. Staging relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: assumed vast, impure in wandering. Paradox relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-exultation: incomplete confessed, Lord kept. Confession relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: god does, self does. Mirroring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: expansion sung, contraction called. Naming relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: willing glimpse, deemed powers. Willing relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-wonder: withdrawn, gracing, veiling. Grace relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: jewel ever-near, unknowing cloddish. Nearness relished.*

C1 commentary · 211 words
## bodh-p03-v21 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Who walks by true reflection's power always is freed of all bonds, bliss-full. Fire swallows, well-awake; all-devouring to be known when pure. United by this power, freedom-marked attains purity soon, doubtless. Power grown, universe shines knowing-made; nectar-wave outward. Gone still, form-shown: self plays Lord supreme. Always-knowing frees; freed frees scores instantly. Bliss-powered established; rising-joy-thus bridges onward. Fixed-nature desired even distracted; effort-power attains. Middle opened, bliss-knowing shines; divine vision manifested. Immaculate ranks expand bodiless knowing-vision. *Rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: practiced, freed, full. Practice relished. The sthāyibhāva is fierce exultation: swallowed, known. Devouring relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: joined, attained, soon. Attainment relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: grown, shining, breaking. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is playful peace: still, shown, playing. Play relished. The sthāyibhāva is compassion-exultation: known, freed, freeing. Freeing relished. The sthāyibhāva is peace: powered, standing, bridging. Standing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: fixed, distracted, still desired. Desire relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: opened middle, shown vision. Vision relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: spotless, bodiless, expanding. Expansion relished.*

C1 commentary · 212 words
## bodh-p04-v31 — C1 **SUMMARY.** Opening holds means: powerful thought-decay-opening state, manifold. Nothing thought, thoughts decay; play-power enamoured in being's field. Attached sees; tightening brahma-teachers call it — fie. Rest-points and passion-grasps listed whole. Goddess-voiced opening; strong obtain supreme reward in days. Samādhi-impressed roams pure-rayed, reflecting by emission-power doubled. Even distracted, own form shines for awareness-fixed bliss-essenced yogi. Bliss-manifest mantra-strong full-I-knowing: inward devotee's. Sporting stayed mantra-situated; strong playing power-expanded. Freedom his, everywhere, world-Lord's, difference-tasting, wonder-state-unbroken. *Rasa: vīra of means; śānta-vīra of decayed thoughts; vīra of recorded calling; adbhuta of listed rests; vīra of goddess-voiced reward; vīra of doubled reflecting; vīra of distraction-proof shining; vīra of mantra-strength; līlā-vīra of situated sport; vīra of unbroken freedom — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: opened middle, powerful stand. Means relished. The sthāyibhāva is peaceful exultation: nothing thought, thoughts decayed. Decay relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: seen bright, called tight. Quoting relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: rests listed whole. Listing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: spoken goddess, won reward. Voicing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: roaming, reflecting, doubled. Roaming relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: distracted even, shining full. Shining relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: manifest, strengthened, devotee's. Strength relished. The sthāyibhāva is playful exultation: stayed, strong, sporting. Situating relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: free, tasting, unbroken. Unbrokenness relished.*
